FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Creamy Delights Dairy Shop, we specialize in providing a delightful selection of dairy products and handmade ice cream in a welcoming retail environment. Our operations focus on crafting high-quality ice cream using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, while adhering to strict food safety and health regulations. We have implemented a comprehensive staff training program to ensure that all employees, including seasonal workers, are well-versed in food safety practices, customer service, and allergen awareness. Our store maintains a clean and inviting atmosphere, backed by documented equipment maintenance and cleaning schedules to prevent any operational risks. Moreover, we are committed to conducting annual risk assessments to proactively identify and mitigate potential hazards. By fostering a strong relationship with reputable suppliers and maintaining high standards of ingredient labeling, we minimize product liability exposure and prioritize our customers' health and safety.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2023, a malfunction in the freezer unit caused a loss of inventory amounting to $2,000. The issue was promptly resolved, and the affected products were replaced. Status: Closed.

FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty commercial safe with UL Class 350 fire rating, suitable for cash and important documents, installed in a secure area of the shop.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance camera system installed, backed by a maintenance plan.
